description.value: Sushi Wara is a Japanese restaurant in Qualicum Beach specializing in sushi and traditional Japanese cuisine. The restaurant provides online ordering for convenient meal stops. It serves the Qualicum Beach community as a useful dining option for touring cyclists passing through the area.
